# 🚀 Pull Request

## 📋 Description
Brief description of what this PR does.

## 🎯 Type of Change
- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] 💥 Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] 📚 Documentation update
- [ ] 🔒 Security improvement
- [ ] 🎨 UI/UX improvement
- [ ] ⚡ Performance improvement

## 🔗 Related Issues
Fixes #(issue number)

## 🧪 Testing
- [ ] I have tested this change locally
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works
- [ ] New and existing unit tests pass locally with my changes
- [ ] I have tested with different file formats (PDF, images)
- [ ] I have tested with multiple languages

## 🏥 Healthcare Considerations
- [ ] This change maintains medical data privacy
- [ ] No real patient data was used in testing
- [ ] Medical disclaimers are appropriate and clear
- [ ] Feature follows healthcare best practices

## 🔒 Security Checklist
- [ ] Input validation is implemented
- [ ] No sensitive data is logged or exposed
- [ ] Authentication/authorization is properly handled
- [ ] Dependencies are up to date and secure

## 📱 UI/UX Checklist (if applicable)
- [ ] Responsive design works on mobile devices
- [ ] Accessibility standards are met
- [ ] Medical theme and branding are consistent
- [ ] Loading states and error handling are implemented

## 🌍 Internationalization (if applicable)
- [ ] Feature works with multiple languages
- [ ] Text is properly externalized for translation
- [ ] Cultural considerations are addressed
- [ ] Voice features work with different languages

## 📸 Screenshots (if applicable)
Add screenshots to show the changes.

## 📋 Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the style guidelines of this project
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas
- [ ] I have made corresponding changes to the documentation
- [ ] My changes generate no new warnings
- [ ] Any dependent changes have been merged and published

## 🚀 Deployment Notes
Any special deployment considerations or environment variable changes needed.

## 📞 Additional Notes
Any additional information that reviewers should know.
